attributes.action: Make Bank of England target inflation, growth and rate stability all at 2-3%
attributes.additional_details: Inflation was energy-led - gas from 54p to 450p per therm - not caused by mortgages, rents or business loans. Yet BoE raised rates to 5.25%, deepening cost of living crisis. Mortgages £800 to £1350pm, rents up 20%, business loans 8-9%, savers didn't get this rate either. Growth only 1.3% in 2025, debt 95% of GDP - hard to manage finances. Curing energy inflation with interest rates is absurd - address specific issues with specific tools. Don't make everyone pay for inflation they didn't cause.
attributes.background: Bank of England raises rates regardless of inflation's cause — like giving paracetamol for every disease. We call on Parliament to legislate a Triple Mandate: inflation, growth and interest rate stability — all at 2–3% — so monetary policy serves everyone, not just inflation target alone.

rejection.details:
We find this petition unclear and do not understand from the text how the Triple Mandate you mention would function - would the new statutory position be advisory or would this be expected to bind the Govt and/or the BofE in some way? 

You may wish to submit another petition setting out your ask more clearly.
